title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Ezra 2: the list of the exiles who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem and Judah.

questions.text: Whose name comes first in the list of leaders the returning exiles came with?
questions.explanation: The children of the province came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, and the other leaders named.

questions.text: How many children of Parosh are listed?
questions.explanation: The children of Parosh were two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

questions.text: Which family is listed with six hundred sixty-six?
questions.explanation: The children of Adonikam were six hundred sixty-six.

questions.text: The singers were the children of whom?
questions.explanation: The singers were the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

questions.text: From which places did those go up who could not show their fathers' houses?
questions.explanation: Those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer could not show their fathers' houses.

questions.text: Why was the ancestor of the priestly children of Barzillai called by that name?
questions.explanation: Barzillai took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

answers.text: He was born in a town called Barzillai
He served as high priest under Barzillai
He took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite
He lived in Barzillai's house in Babylon

questions.text: Why were the children of Habaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai removed from the priesthood?
questions.explanation: They sought their place among those registered by genealogy, but they were not found, so they were removed from the priesthood.

answers.text: They had touched a dead body
They refused to go up to Jerusalem
Their registration by genealogy was not found

questions.text: Until when were they not to eat of the most holy things?
questions.explanation: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.

answers.text: Until a priest stood up with Urim and Thummim
Until the king of Persia allowed it

questions.text: How many was the whole assembly together?
questions.explanation: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty.

questions.text: Besides gold and silver, what did the heads of fathers' households give into the treasury?
questions.explanation: They gave sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.
